brief_rationale: The doctor systematically established right-eye cataract surgery as the episode focus, clarified the left-eye prior IOL history, screened for red-flag symptoms, reconciled the discharge levofloxacin plan, separated preoperative from discharge medications, built a family execution plan with logging and handoff, ensured ophthalmology follow-up receipt, addressed diabetes/hypertension without self-stopping, and used workspace evidence without fabricating. All eight responsibility-chain items are met without error. Three high-order points (HO2, HO3, HO4) were actively triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact: the doctor uncovered and reconciled the left/right laterality confusion, closed with explicit bounded-risk reasoning and caregiver teach-back, and verified ambiguous postoperative improvement against targeted screening and medication reliability. The trajectory thus satisfies Strong and meets the Perfect threshold via two completed high-order points.
